intent: Reduce first-purchase ambiguity by making the 14-Day Verifiable Research Sprint the single primary commercial CTA while retaining the existing five DS configurations as secondary fulfillment/expansion paths.

hero_patch.title: 14-Day Verifiable Research Sprint
hero_patch.headline: Rendez un claim de recherche vérifiable par un tiers — sans rendre publiques les données qui ne servent pas à la preuve.
hero_patch.body: En cinq jours de production à distance répartis sur une fenêtre cible de 14 jours, nous transformons un claim borné en paquet de vérification : sources et versions, graphe claim→evidence, provenance, capsule de replay ou d’inspection, frontière d’accès, tests d’acceptation et reviewer pack. Blockchain, attestations ou ZK ne sont retenus que s’ils ajoutent une propriété d’assurance mesurable par rapport à une baseline centralisée signée.
hero_patch.secondary_cta: Tester gratuitement la méthode — DeSci 140 h

price_reference.label: Repère actuel pour 5 jours de production à distance
price_reference.note: Le devis final reste déterminé par le moteur public selon la mission, la complexité, la durée et la logistique.

value_equation.dream_outcome: One bounded research claim can be handed to an independent reviewer as a coherent verification package.
value_equation.likelihood: Increase through pre-written acceptance gates, explicit claim/evidence lineage, replay or inspection instructions, and a reviewer receipt.
value_equation.time_delay: Target 14 calendar days for the entry sprint.
value_equation.effort: Buyer supplies one claim/workflow, one accountable owner, controlled evidence access, two 45-minute working sessions and one 60-minute final review.

core_deliverables: Architecture decision record comparing conventional signed baseline vs selective verifiable mechanism

risk_reversal.name: Artifact Completeness Commitment
risk_reversal.terms: If the sponsor provides agreed inputs and access on time and an agreed mandatory artifact is incomplete at the final acceptance gate, remedial production continues for up to two additional remote production days at no extra consulting fee.

scarcity_and_urgency.scarcity: Publish capacity only from measured CRM delivery capacity; never invent slot counts.
scarcity_and_urgency.urgency: Use real buyer decision windows and the public quote validity period; no artificial countdown.

existing_ds_offer_mapping.DS-O1: Absorbed into entry-sprint claim/verifier/property mapping rather than marketed as a competing first purchase.
existing_ds_offer_mapping.DS-O2: Becomes an optional sprint expansion when architecture work exceeds the bounded entry scope.
existing_ds_offer_mapping.DS-O3: Becomes the default post-sprint PoC expansion.

publication_gates: The public desci-140h product route resolves and is linked from the catalogue.
At least one real allowed-source capstone submission exists.
At least one independent verification receipt exists.
Any numeric scarcity reflects real CRM capacity.
The risk-reversal wording is owner-approved before publication.
No sentence implies scientific, clinical, regulatory, reviewer or doctoral-school acceptance.
